name: Nice Olive Paste
about: A smooth olive spread, often made into tapenade, that Nice is known for. It reflects the olive traditions of the Provence region around the city.
tip: Pack it well in checked luggage, since jars can leak.

name: Fragonard Perfume
about: A perfume from a South of France brand rooted in Grasse's long perfume tradition. Grasse is a short trip from Nice and is famous for its fragrance houses.
tip: Choose a smaller bottle if you want an easy, travel-friendly gift.
